title: ci(lint): shrink lint.yml by 122,702 bytes (510,016 → 387,314), comment lines only
body:
Fixes #23044
Clause-②: no

## What this does

`.github/workflows/lint.yml` stood at **510,016 bytes** on `main` @ `df7a13792`. The card measured GitHub rejecting this file at 513,738 bytes (a workflow-file run with zero jobs, and neither required context reporting), so `main` had under 3.7 KB of margin. 87% of the file's bytes were YAML comment lines. This PR removes comment lines only and leaves every key and value untouched.

| | before (`df7a13792`) | after (`fc9340b61`) |
|---|---|---|
| bytes | 510,016 | **387,314** (−122,702, −24.1%) |
| lines (`wc -l`) | 8,082 | 6,358 |
| lines whose first non-blank char is `#` | 6,266 | 4,542 |
| bytes in those lines / share of the file | 445,409 / 87.3% | 322,707 / 83.3% |

(19 of the `#`-led lines are shell comments inside `run: |` block scalars. This PR touches none of them.) Changed lines: **+136 / −1,860 = 1,996**, under the 3,000 human-merge line.

- **60 per-step rationale blocks** became a pointer of one or two lines: `# Rationale: SCRIPT header (#cards).`, naming the script whose header already carries that rationale.
- **29 verbatim duplicate copies** of a lane note (the same note pasted into each of the eight `Lint · *` lanes or the four `Type Check · *` lanes) became a pointer to the first copy. The first copy stays verbatim.
- **5 step notes** from the removed blocks are kept on the pointer, one or two lines each: three ⛔ "self-test only" warnings (prior-ruling reader, release-index currency rewriter, stall-guard headroom), the export-origins ordering note, and the skills-liveness "unfiltered" note that `scripts/pm/bare-root-worklist.mjs` cites as "stated in the step comment".
- **One file-level note added** (9 lines, after the GATE ORDER note). Many removed blocks repeated "it lives in this job because it has no paths filter". That argument is now stated once, at the top of the file.
- **No new `docs/` file.** Every removed rationale already lives in a script header, so nothing had to move there.

Item 1 of the card (a new `check:*` size gate) is not built: the dispatch scoped this PR to item 2, because the seat's instrument rule requires the maintainer's words on the card for a new gate and the card quotes none.

## How the blocks were chosen (measured)

Every YAML comment block was found with the `yaml` 2.9.1 `Lexer`, so a `#` line inside a block scalar is never treated as a comment. Each block was then resolved to the step it precedes, and the step to the scripts its `run:` invokes, through the root and package `package.json` scripts. A block qualified only when both of these hold:

1. the invoked script has a header (its leading comment) of at least 40 lines, and
2. **every card number the block cites (`#NNNN`) is also cited by that script file.**

119 blocks qualified. The 60 largest were taken, minus two kept on purpose. The `typecheck-debt` `NODE_OPTIONS` block stays because it argues the step's own `env:` coupling. The docs image-tag rewriter block (`#9064`) stays because `scripts/sync-template-versions.mjs` quotes it. Every pointer line also carries every card number its removed block cited, so a search of `lint.yml` for a card still lands on its step. In 58 of the 60 the cards are cited in the script's **header**. In the other two (`check-closing-target-claim.mjs`, `build-export-origins.ts`) they are cited in the script body. The ⛔/⚠️ sentences of each removed block were compared with the script text (3-gram overlap). Where a step-wiring warning was not stated in the script in the same words, it was kept on the pointer.

The full prior text of every removed block remains at `df7a13792:.github/workflows/lint.yml`.

## Proof of no behaviour change

- **YAML data identical.** Base and head were each loaded as data by two parsers, and both compare equal:
  - `yaml` 2.9.1 (`parse`, strict, `uniqueKeys`): deep-equal, sha256 of the JSON `2b8d629828681750` on both sides.
  - PyYAML 6.0.1 (`safe_load`): equal, `e04c40c7a827bfbb` on both sides.
- **Only comment lines changed.** `git diff -U0 df7a13792 fc9340b61` has 0 changed lines that are not `#`-led.
- **Names byte-identical.** 14 jobs and 344 steps, with every job name unchanged. That covers the required contexts `Lint & Repo Gates` and `TypeScript Type Check`, and all eight `Lint · *` lanes.

## Readers of `lint.yml` comments (dispatch assumption 4)

**Searched:** every file under `scripts/`, `packages/` and `.claude/hooks/` with a code-level (non-comment) string literal naming `lint.yml`, `.github/workflows` or `workflows`. That is 89 files. They include the candidates the dispatch named:

- `check-comment-mask-corpus` and `docs-audit/check-drift-comment`: these read JS/TS and the docs-drift workflow, not `lint.yml` comments.
- `check-aggregator-roster`, `check-step-collectors`, `check-self-test-wired`, `check-self-test-workflow-commands` and `dispatch-gates`: these read step structure and `run:` text.

The scripts that literally read `lint.yml` text were found as well: the wiring self-tests that `includes()` the raw text, the `check-changeset-no-major` job slicer, and `check-type-check-coverage`'s raw `typecheck:root` / `turbo run typecheck` regexes.

**Measured:** a copy of `lint.yml` with **all** 6,247 YAML comment lines removed (66,120 bytes, parsed data still identical) was swapped in. 76 reader commands were run against it: 40 of the 43 dispatch-derived commands, the dispatch's `check-ci-filter-parity` and `check:doc-authoring`, and 34 commands for the other literal readers. The three derived commands left out were `check:pm-dispatch-gates` and `check:type-check-debt` (both heavy, run on the final head below) and `check-comment-mask-corpus` (it reads JS/TS only). The swap was restored by `git checkout HEAD --` and the restore was proved by blob hash.

- All 76 exited 0, as they did on base.
- 72 of 76 printed byte-identical output once timings were normalised.
- The other four changed only prose counts or line numbers, never a verdict:
  - `check-whole-set-label-write`: mentions in comments, cleared, 12 → 9.
  - `check:agent-test-spelling`: separators judged 11 → 10.
  - `check:pnpm-filter-targets`: "more in comments" 62 → 54.
  - `check:pnpm-acquisition`: line numbers.

So no reader pins a `lint.yml` comment, and nothing had to be kept for a reader.

### 改了什么
把 `.github/workflows/lint.yml` 里的 1,860 行注释换成了 136 行指针。删掉的主要是每个检查步骤前面大段"为什么要有这个检查"的说明。这些理由在对应检查脚本的文件头里本来就有,指针直接指过去。同一段说明被逐字复制进多个并行 lane 的,只保留第一份。文件从 510,016 字节降到 387,314 字节,少了约 24%。

### 为什么改
GitHub 对单个 workflow 文件有大小上限。卡片实测:文件到 513,738 字节时,GitHub 判它无效,一个 job 都不跑,两个必需检查(`Lint & Repo Gates`、`TypeScript Type Check`)都不上报。必需检查不上报,PR 和合并队列就会卡住。改之前,main 离这条线不到 4 KB,下一个往 lint.yml 里加检查的 PR 就可能踩线。现在,离最后一次实测有效的大小还有约 122 KB 余量。
